product.title: Private Custom Full-Day Highlights in Rio: Only the Best Sights!

description.text: In Rio de Janeiro, this private 8-to-9-hour outing starts at Corcovado and Christ the Redeemer, continues to Escadaria Selaron and Sugarloaf Mountain, then offers an afternoon choice of historic center, Tijuca Forest, or Santa Teresa. A driver-guide or a separate guide and driver stay with one group. Pickup is listed from hotels including Barra da Tijuca, plus airports and the cruise terminal. Entry tickets and lunch are not treated as guaranteed inclusions on the published page. History-focused afternoons use Cinelandia, the Metropolitan Cathedral, and the Etnias mural; nature-focused afternoons use Cascatinha Taunay and Pepino Beach. The format suits visitors who want a customizable guided day without booking three separate circuits. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Rio de Janeiro, and the itinerary stays on Corcovado, Escadaria Selaron, and Sugarloaf Mountain that define this private circuit rather than a Petrópolis imperial add-on.

highlights: Private 8-to-9-hour circuit of Christ the Redeemer, Sugarloaf Mountain, and Escadaria Selaron
